Description: Set up Next.js 14 with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui scaffold
Acceptance Criteria: Project runs locally without errors; TypeScript strict mode enabled; Tailwind configured

Description: Create .env.example with NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
Acceptance Criteria: All required env vars documented and validated at build time

Description: Create Supabase project, configure auth providers, set up PostgreSQL database
Acceptance Criteria: Supabase project created; auth enabled; database accessible; migrations structure in place

Description: Create tables for users, contracts, extractions, payment_schedules, risk_flags
Acceptance Criteria: All tables created with RLS policies; foreign keys defined; indexes on frequently queried columns

Description: Add RLS policies to all tables to ensure users can only access their own data
Acceptance Criteria: Users can only read/write their own contracts; RLS policies tested; no data leakage

Description: Create landing page with value prop, construction contract benefits, CTA to upload
Acceptance Criteria: Page responsive on mobile/tablet/desktop; copy emphasizes construction-specific value; upload CTA is prominent

Description: Build file upload widget that accepts .docx and .pdf files
Acceptance Criteria: Drag-and-drop works; file validation on client-side (docx/pdf only); file size limits enforced

Description: Create TypeScript client for Anthropic API with error handling and retry logic
Acceptance Criteria: Client instantiated with API key; requests retry on transient errors; usage tracking in place

Description: Engineer and test extraction prompt for payment terms, dates, risk flags
Acceptance Criteria: Prompt extracts: payment method, amount, schedule, retainage %, lien waiver terms, completion milestones

Description: Parse Claude response into typed ContractExtraction object
Acceptance Criteria: Extracted data matches schema; fallback handling for partial extractions; error messages clear

Description: Implement sign-up, login, logout, password reset flows
Acceptance Criteria: Users can register and log in; auth state persists; logout clears session; password reset sends email

Description: Implement Next.js middleware to protect dashboard and API routes
Acceptance Criteria: Unauthenticated users redirected to login; dashboard routes require session; API routes check auth headers

Task: Implement File Upload to Supabase Storage
Description: Upload files to Supabase storage bucket with user-scoped paths
Acceptance Criteria: Files stored at user_id/{contract_id}/{filename}; file size validated; upload progress tracked

Description: Display upload progress and status feedback to user
Acceptance Criteria: Progress bar shows % complete; loading state shown; success/error messages displayed; user can retry on failure

Description: Display Claude-extracted payment terms in a clean, readable format
Acceptance Criteria: Shows: payment method, amounts, dates, retainage %, lien waiver terms; terms are editable; preview refreshes on edit

Description: Manage extraction state and sync edits back to database
Acceptance Criteria: Edits saved to contract record; preview shows latest data; changes persist across page refreshes

Description: Users can upload and see extraction preview without signing up; must register to see full results
Acceptance Criteria: Unauth users upload → see preview; CTA in preview to "View Full Results"; clicking CTA requires signup

Description: Clean modal that prompts signup at the right moment (after preview, before results)
Acceptance Criteria: Modal appears after preview loaded; explains value of full results; login/signup forms in modal; dismissible

Description: Implement logic to auto-generate payment schedules from extracted contract terms
Acceptance Criteria: Calculates progress draws, retainage holds, release conditions; handles milestone-based and time-based draws

Description: Implement retainage release tied to substantial completion, lien waiver receipt, or time triggers
Acceptance Criteria: Retainage released on: (a) substantial completion, (b) final lien waiver, (c) time threshold; logic configurable

Description: Add logic to track stored materials and incorporate into payment schedule if contract allows
Acceptance Criteria: Stored materials identified; added to schedule if contract permits; flagged for compliance review if ambiguous

Description: Create visual timeline showing payment draws, milestones, retainage holds, and release events
Acceptance Criteria: Timeline shows: draw dates, amounts, milestones, retainage release date; clickable for detail view; responsive

Description: UI to edit extracted milestones (dates, % completion, names)
Acceptance Criteria: Milestone list editable inline; add/remove milestones; validation (dates in order, % totals 100%)

Description: Component to view and edit extracted payment amounts per milestone/phase
Acceptance Criteria: Shows: phase, amount, % of total, notes; editable; totals recalculate; changes flow to schedule calculation

Description: Generate .xlsx file with payment schedule (draws, dates, amounts, retainage)
Acceptance Criteria: File downloads with: schedule table, summary page, assumptions; formatting clean; file named by contract

Description: Generate PDF with payment schedule, timeline, terms summary, formatted for printing/sharing
Acceptance Criteria: PDF includes: title, contract summary, payment schedule table, timeline graphic, footer with date/user

Description: Side-by-side view: extracted contract terms vs. simplified payment schedule
Acceptance Criteria: Shows: original contract excerpt, simplified schedule; highlights mapping; lets user reconcile differences

Description: Implement logic to identify and flag pay-when-paid and pay-if-paid clauses
Acceptance Criteria: Detects: pay-when-paid language; pay-if-paid language; flags severity (high/medium); explains impact

Description: Identify non-standard retainage triggers or release conditions that create risk
Acceptance Criteria: Flags: non-standard retainage %; unusual release conditions; missing substantial completion link; explanations clear

Description: Identify lien waiver requirements and timing that create payment or compliance risk
Acceptance Criteria: Detects: unconditional waiver demands; timing conflicts; partial waiver ambiguity; flags for review

Task: Implement State Prompt Payment Act Checker
Description: Check contract terms against 50+ state prompt payment laws; flag violations
Acceptance Criteria: Detects: state from contract; checks against state prompt payment act; flags missing protections; explains law

Description: Curate and structure state prompt payment law data (timeframes, exceptions, lien requirements)
Acceptance Criteria: Database includes: all 50 states + territories; key dates/thresholds; exemptions; updated as laws change

Description: Create high/medium/low severity risk display with explanations and mitigation steps
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard shows: risk count by severity; detail cards with explanation + mitigation; search/filter by type

Description: Calculate overall contract risk score based on detected flags; recommend mitigation actions
Acceptance Criteria: Score calculated from flag severity/count; recommendations tailored to specific risks; score updates as contract changes

Description: Track lien waiver requirements: due dates, required parties, status (pending/received/released)
Acceptance Criteria: Component shows: waiver due dates, required parties, status; updates user when due; integrable with notifications

Description: Generate audit-ready PDF with all flagged risks, explanations, state law references, mitigation recommendations
Acceptance Criteria: PDF includes: executive summary, all flags with severity, state law citations, mitigation matrix, audit trail

Description: Use Claude to explain why each risk flag matters and suggest practical mitigation steps
Acceptance Criteria: For each flag: Claude generates 2-3 sentence explanation + concrete mitigation action; tone is advisory, not alarmist

Description: Create project list view (create, view, delete, archive contracts/projects)
Acceptance Criteria: Users see project list; can create new; click to view contracts; delete/archive available; empty state helpful

Description: API endpoints to create, read, update, delete projects; enforce user ownership via RLS
Acceptance Criteria: POST /api/projects (create); GET /api/projects (list); PATCH /api/projects/:id; DELETE /api/projects/:id

Description: Query user's past contract analyses; show list with dates, contract names, status
Acceptance Criteria: History view lists: contract name, upload date, last modified, status, link to view results; sortable

Description: API endpoints to fetch user's contract history and past analyses with pagination
Acceptance Criteria: GET /api/contracts (list by user); GET /api/contracts/:id (retrieve); supports filter/sort/pagination

Description: Allow users to tag contracts (project, client, status) and mark as favorites for quick access
Acceptance Criteria: Tag management UI; tag-based filtering; favorites appear at top of list; tags stored and retrieved

Description: Compact view with key terms, major risks, payment schedule at a glance
Acceptance Criteria: Summary shows: contract type, total value, payment method, retainage %, top 3 risks, next payment date

Description: Generate shareable links (unauthenticated) to view contract results (read-only)
Acceptance Criteria: Share button generates unique link; link expires after 30 days; recipients can view but not edit; access logged

Description: UI for managing who can access a contract (team members, collaborators); scaffolding for future team features
Acceptance Criteria: Share modal lists: current sharing status, option to generate link, future: invite team members (scaffolded)

Description: Test full flow: upload → extraction → preview → signup → schedule → export → dashboard
Acceptance Criteria: Smoke test all user flows; spot-check extraction quality; verify exports open correctly; mobile test

Description: Optimize page load times, API response times, and extraction latency; measure with Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals
Acceptance Criteria: Lighthouse score >90; API responses <500ms; extraction <10s for typical contract; image optimization

Description: Add error tracking (Sentry), logging, and user-facing error messages for all failure modes
Acceptance Criteria: Errors logged to Sentry; user gets helpful message (not stack trace); retries transparent; downtime notification

Description: Configure Vercel deployment, set up env vars, preview environments, and CI/CD pipeline
Acceptance Criteria: App deployed to Vercel; preview deployments on PRs; main branch auto-deploys; build <60s

Description: Configure error tracking, performance monitoring, and alerts for production issues
Acceptance Criteria: Sentry alerts on errors; Vercel analytics monitoring; PagerDuty/email alerts for critical issues
